breakouts.h: Next up: the breakout candidates for the new season
breakouts.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

list.name: M.Fuller
list.d: [[p:557714494|M.Fuller]] saw his release off the line (79 to 99) and short route running (69 to 89) take a big step in training. Also: he jumped from 70 to 82 overall this offseason. He slides into the starting lineup with D.Carr gone. By October, everyone will know it.

list.name: P.Levine
list.d: [[p:557720960|P.Levine]] came out of the offseason at 82 overall, up from 70. On top of that, he saw his release off the line (77 to 92) and short route running (73 to 88) take a big step in training. He slides into the starting lineup with G.Kontosis, J.Tabb and D.Virgin gone. By October, everyone will know it.

list.name: D.Uche
list.d: [[p:557728461|D.Uche]] came out of the offseason at 84 overall, up from 74. On top of that, he saw his hands (74 to 84) and spectacular-catch ability (76 to 86) take a big step in training. Plus, he slides into the starting lineup with O.Slay, M.Hamrick and J.Westerman gone. This is the year.

list.name: L.Naanee
list.d: [[p:557717923|L.Naanee]] saw his release off the line (67 to 87) and short route running (64 to 84) take a big step in training. Better yet, he jumped from 65 to 78 overall this offseason. And he brings a route artist skill set to a scheme that ranks 20th in receptions. Don't be surprised to see him on an all-conference team.

list.d: [[p:557711974|J.Gastineau]] jumped from 63 to 76 overall this offseason. Also: he saw his man coverage (74 to 88) and press coverage (53 to 67) take a big step in training. And he slides into the starting lineup with D.Lanier and K.Harmon gone. Ball State fans are about to get a new favorite player.

He slides into the starting lineup with O.Stubbs, J.Kasay and J.Fung gone. San Jose State fans are about to get a new favorite player.

list.name: J.Hodges
list.d: [[p:557714806|J.Hodges]] came out of the offseason at 80 overall, up from 69. Add this: he saw his man coverage (74 to 89) and press coverage (73 to 87) take a big step in training. He slides into the starting lineup with R.Stroud gone. By October, everyone will know it.

list.d: [[p:557724103|J.Yarborough]] jumped from 71 to 81 overall this offseason. Better yet, he saw his hands (67 to 79) and zone coverage (72 to 82) take a big step in training. And he landed at [[t:832438358|Ohio]] through the portal and walks into a starting job. Circle his name now.
